blocks.text: CALUMPIT, Bulacan — Residents of this flood-prone Bulacan town marched in the streets over the weekend to demand full transparency as public works crews proceed with flood control infrastructure that were tied to anomalies last year. Zul Kifli Magat, spokesperson of the movement Tindig Calumpitenyo, led a 1,500-strong rally on Sunday (September 20); marking the first anniversary since massive anomalies were detected in many flood-control projects of the First District Engineering Office of the Department of Public Works and Highways. Counted among the anomalies was a P54-million flood-control project in Calumpit. READ: Calumpit declares state of calamity The protesters representing various […]...
